CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_account_technical_evasion_risk AS
SELECT 
    t1.accindex,
    (0.4 * t2.vpnratio) + (0.3 * t2.proxycount / 10) + (0.3 * t2.ipcountrynum / 20) AS technical_evasion_index,
    CASE 
        WHEN (0.4 * t2.vpnratio) + (0.3 * t2.proxycount / 10) + (0.3 * t2.ipcountrynum / 20) < 0.3 THEN 'Low'
        WHEN (0.4 * t2.vpnratio) + (0.3 * t2.proxycount / 10) + (0.3 * t2.ipcountrynum / 20) < 0.6 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'High'
    END AS risk_level
FROM 
    account AS t1
JOIN 
    technicalinfo AS t2 ON t1.accindex = t2.techkey;
